headline: W.W. Grainger’s (NYSE:GWW) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue But Stock Drops
summary: Maintenance and repair supplier W.W. Grainger (NYSE:GWW) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.3% year on year to $5.02 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $19.55 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $12.01 per share was 7.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
